derivation_rules: Pixel coordinates may be measured only against verified original image SHA and pixel dimensions.
Single uncalibrated perspective image does not determine unique 3D coordinates, depth, height, or slope.
Do not infer metres from legacy runtime map tile size or unitScale.
A reference metre length is insufficient to recover perspective depth without camera calibration or additional constrained views.
Retain image-derived 2D contours as 2D; mark reconstructed 3D separately with method and uncertainty.
Native measured coordinates, reconstructed estimates, hypothetical design, and unknowns must have distinct status.

unblock: Locate approved original CG and verify SHA, dimensions, provenance and approval.
Identify calibrated view(s) or independent metric constraints.
Extract pixel-space landmarks and uncertainty with reproducible script.
Check owner-approved protected scope before native sculpt or Studio publication.
